row.notes: Needs the target node self+0x80 and a non-empty list (item_list+8..+0x10). Reads the id at +0x40 of that node's component of type 0x146ca5498 and looks it up in the UiSystem (vt+0x68) hash map at +0xa8..+0xdc; if the entry has bit 1 at +0x170 it only sets bit 4 at self+0x119 and returns. Otherwise it sends message 0x12 (table 0x14588dd50) for the target node and for self, computes an offset vector from the layout object (+0x1a0, fields +0xf0..+0x11c) of the first or last focusable item or of the selection self+0x108, sends message 0x11 (table 0x14588dd80) with self id, component ids, rate self+0x8c (0 when bit 4 at +0x11a) and the offset, optionally message 0x13, and clears bit 4 at +0x119 and +0x11a. Callers: Ui_TileList_ScrollToChild after it chose self+0x80, and the tick 0x14383b950 to restart a pending scroll. The meaning of messages 0x11/0x12/0x13 (play/stop) is inferred. Better context needed: the handlers 0x1438fbd20, 0x1438fb980, 0x1438fb230. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
